# Acme

> A multi-tenant to-do application for teams of people and the agents that work alongside them, built as the reference implementation of the Software Design and Architecture Guidelines: one object model at the center, one infrastructure toolkit, an API process and a maintenance worker around them, and a portal, a command line, and a Python client at the edge.

This file is the knowledge map. Each section lists the documents one
audience is served; a document not listed under an audience is not
served to it. Exposure is by listing, never by folder.

## Platform developers

- [README](README.md): what Acme is, the quick start, how to set up, run, check, deploy, and operate it, and the layout
- [As built](docs/architecture.md): every namespace, process, and check as it exists in this repository
- [Decisions](docs/adr/): the architecture decision records, one file per decision
- [What Acme is made of](om/README.md): the nouns and how they relate, for a reader with no code
- [Tenancy](om/src/acme/om/tenancy/README.md): orgs (every person's one personal org, and the team orgs they make), identities, users, memberships, sessions, API keys, socket tickets, the role ladder, sign-in through the identity provider (a first sign-in is the sign-up; the device sign-in; the local sign-in), the sign-out that ends any credential it is given and the provider's session too, operator tokens listed and revoked one at a time, invitations, single sign-on, the switch between orgs, and deleting my account
- [Tasks](om/src/acme/om/tasks/README.md): the to-do items, the rank a move writes one task by, the sweep's respace, the version every write names, and a task's attachments
- [Orchestrations](om/src/acme/om/orchestrations/README.md): long-running records (the import of tasks from a CSV file, the daily cleanup of old done tasks), the step that lands its effect and its cursor in one commit, the park on the plan and its wake, and the bound that fails
- [Files](om/src/acme/om/media/README.md): files as references, the bounded upload straight to the store, the confirm, the purpose (an attachment, a dictation, an import), the storage used, and the sweep
- [Tasks](om/src/acme/om/tasks/README.md): the to-do items, the rank a move writes one task by, the version every write names, and the due date and its one reminder
- [Slack](om/src/acme/om/slack/README.md): the app an org installs into its workspace, its bot token kept as the org's own secret and renewed, the install's one-time state, the channel `/acme connect` binds, and the record of every post
- [Billing](om/src/acme/om/billing/README.md): plans, their bounds as levers, the org's account at the payment processor, deliveries applied once, and grants
- [Events](om/src/acme/om/events/README.md): the org's diary and its gapless sequence
- [Work items](om/src/acme/om/work/README.md): background jobs, the claim, and the lease
- [Idempotency records](om/src/acme/om/idempotency/README.md): the outcome of a request that may arrive twice
- [Outbox rows](om/src/acme/om/outbox/README.md): the note written beside every change
- [Infrastructure](infra/README.md): cache, buckets, topics, queues, secrets, observability; what each promises and which twin runs where
- [Integrations](integrations/README.md): the third-party providers, each an interface, a real client, and a twin: Slack (its install, its signed calls in, its tokens), the identity provider (WorkOS), and the payment processor (Stripe); the errors a caller decides on; what a provider that hangs costs a call, and the request's deadline its calls share
- [The API process](services/api/README.md): the routes by area, the gateway's guarantees, the subcommands
- [The maintenance worker](workers/maintenance/README.md): claim, handle, complete; reminders and Slack posts; a deleted account's providers; what Slack sends; the sweep and its count of the platform's size; liveness
- [Deployment](deployment/README.md): the two twins and the branch convention
- [The local stack](deployment/local/README.md): every URL and port, one service at a time
- [Terraform](deployment/terraform/modules/README.md): the roots, the modules, the state, the credentials, and the portal's CDN, which serves the API's paths too
- [Cloud cost](deployment/cloud/README.md): the five sizes, each environment's size, the postures and their budgets
- [Operations](ops/README.md): roles, profiles, credentials, signals, the ops binary, the skills, the audits, the first responder
- [Audit tools](ops/audit/README.md): what the audit skills run: a database of the run's own, the heavy seed, the plans, the database and provider call counter, and the deploy timeline
- [Stress tests](ops/stress/README.md): what a good one is and the scenario file
- [Runbooks](docs/runbooks/README.md): one file per operational procedure
- [Deploy runbook](docs/runbooks/deploy.md): cutting a release, approving a plan, rolling back
- [Operate runbook](docs/runbooks/operate.md): reading an environment under the investigate profile
- [Scale runbook](docs/runbooks/scale.md): the one variable that turns autoscaling on
- [Stripe runbook](docs/runbooks/providers/stripe.md): the payment processor for a newcomer: its levels, the sandbox and the live account, the two restricted keys (runtime and bootstrap) and their permissions, the bootstrap, the webhook secret, local deliveries, rotation, and what breaks
- [WorkOS runbook](docs/runbooks/providers/workos.md): the sign-in provider for a newcomer: its environments, the Acme App application, its own API key (never the environment's) and its Redirects tab (the callbacks and the sign-out URIs), the bootstrap, rotation, and what breaks
- [Slack runbook](docs/runbooks/providers/slack.md): the Slack app for a newcomer: one app per environment from its committed manifest, the signing secret and the client secret, the install per org, the channel, local development with the twin, rotation, and what breaks
- [Support runbook](docs/runbooks/support.md): how a support investigation runs
- [Tenant isolation runbook](docs/runbooks/tenant-isolation.md): the cross-tenant cases and what they catch
- [The portal](apps/portal/README.md): the browser app, which calls the API on its own origin
- [The company site](apps/site/README.md): the static marketing page, its build per environment, and where it is served
- [The command line](apps/cli/README.md): the terminal client and its exit codes
- [The Python client](clients/python/README.md): the one client every Python caller goes through

## Tenant users and admins

- [What Acme is made of](om/README.md): the nouns and how they relate, for a reader with no code
- [Tenancy](om/src/acme/om/tenancy/README.md): orgs (your personal org and the team orgs), people, roles, invitations, single sign-on, credentials, deleting a team org you own, and deleting your account
- [Tasks](om/src/acme/om/tasks/README.md): the to-do items and their rules
- [Orchestrations](om/src/acme/om/orchestrations/README.md): importing tasks from a file, and the archive of old done tasks
- [Files](om/src/acme/om/media/README.md): the files kept with the work, their bounds, and the storage used
- [Tasks](om/src/acme/om/tasks/README.md): the to-do items and their rules, due dates among them
- [Slack](om/src/acme/om/slack/README.md): adding Acme to Slack, picking its channel, what it posts, `/acme`, `/acme team`, and `/acme add`
- [Billing](om/src/acme/om/billing/README.md): the plans, what each allows, and how an org pays
- [Events](om/src/acme/om/events/README.md): the org's diary
- [Work items](om/src/acme/om/work/README.md): background jobs
- [Idempotency records](om/src/acme/om/idempotency/README.md): why a repeated request does one thing
- [Outbox rows](om/src/acme/om/outbox/README.md): why every change is announced
- [The command line](apps/cli/README.md): the terminal client and its exit codes
